integrity: The analytic identities establish the claimed universal and asymptotic results; deterministic numerical evaluations are consistency checks and not proofs. Mathematical priority and independent validation remain unconfirmed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two strictly positive singular modes; fixed integer sketch dimension at least two; independent real Gaussian left sketch; smallest right singular vector computed in exact arithmetic; expected squared principal angle. Higher-dimensional spectra, non-Gaussian sketches, floating-point effects, and tail probabilities are not proved.
title: A two-to-three-row mean-angle transition in Gaussian sketched null-space extraction
